> *Note:* This table lists all individuals who officially affixed their signatures on July 2–5, 1776, when the Continental Congress adopted and later ratified the Declaration of Independence. Some states had multiple delegates; each delegate’s signature appears only once even if they served more than one term.  

If you’d like additional details—such as biographical sketches, where each signer lived at the time, or how many copies were made—you can let me know!
